# SI050 — nondeterministic-python-in-det-path

Deterministic paths must not use random, time, or uuid.

## Why

Wall-clock and randomness differ across validators and break consensus.

## Bad

```python
import random
return random.random()
```

## Good

```python
return canonical_verdict(raw)
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI050 -- reason
```
